from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    diagonals = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 0:
                diagonals.setdefault(r + c, set()).add(value)
    # Parallel anti-diagonal marks encode a repeating pattern along r+c.
    if len(diagonals) >= 2 and all(len(colors) == 1 for colors in diagonals.values()):
        period = len(diagonals)
        phase_colors = {}
        for total, colors in diagonals.items():
            phase_colors[total % period] = next(iter(colors))
        if len(phase_colors) == period:
            return [[phase_colors[(r + c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Full-width colored rows encode phases of a repeating row pattern; zero is background.
    marked = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
              if row[0] != 0 and all(value == row[0] for value in row)]
    period = len(marked)
    phase_colors = {}
    for r, color in marked:
        phase_colors[r % period] = color
    return [[phase_colors[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
path=root/'task-f0d0b53f.py'
path.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program,str(path),'exec'), globals())
test=[[5]*9,[0]*9,[2]*9,[1]*9,[9]*9,[9]*9,[9]*9,[0]*9,[9]*9]
out=transform(test)
